project.title: SynerMix: Synergistic Mixup Solution for Enhanced Intra-Class Cohesion and Inter-Class Separability in Image Classification
project.lead_organization: School of IoT Engineering, Wuxi Institute of Technology

Method.name: SynerMix-Intra
Method.description: A mixup method targeting intra-class mixup to bolster intra-class cohesion by generating synthesized feature representations through random linear interpolation within the same class.

Method.name: SynerMix
Method.description: A synergistic solution combining SynerMix-Intra with existing inter-class mixup approaches to enhance both intra-class cohesion and inter-class separability.

Method.name: MixUp
Method.description: An existing mixup approach primarily focusing on inter-class mixup.

Method.name: Manifold MixUp
Method.description: A variant of MixUp that performs mixing in the hidden layers.
